name: Alkera AI
long_description: Alkera is the AI platform for enterprise data teams, especially in regulated industries where trust isn't optional, with governed agents that handle data engineering, analytics, and data science across a company's entire data stack. Our agents connect to every data tool and application a company runs, from legacy to modern, trace end-to-end lineage across all of them, and operate under strict permissions with full observability into everything they touch, while automatically maintaining a shared team context that includes a knowledge base and semantic layer. Our research division backs the product and services with proprietary techniques, including training models on each company's own data, so enterprises own AI efficiently tuned to their data work.
one_liner: AI platform for enterprise data teams
